objectives.title: A project that has emitted no report yet

phases.title: Runs with nothing filed for them

runs.title: A run in a project with an empty reports index
runs.summary: Its project emits the index and has filed no report in it.
runs.full_description: The state every real repository of this workspace is in today: the index is readable, present, and lists nothing. That is a measurement, not a silence.

runs.title: A second run in the same project
runs.summary: Same state, and the surface must say the same thing about it.
runs.full_description: Two runs so the operator can see that the answer is a property of the project and not of one run.
